breakouts.title: With Jesus When You Are at Work
breakouts.summary: This session will lean into the reality that some of us who feel so deeply called to ministry may never work within the walls of a church. From a paycheck to a platform, learn how to pursue Him when Monday is Ministry!

breakouts.title: Georgia Young Adults Connect
breakouts.summary: Come connect and grow with other Young Adult Ministry leaders.

breakouts.title: With Jesus in Marriage
breakouts.summary: There is a reason that God joined you together. Explore ways that you can work together in this interactive breakout session. Leave with practical tools to practice being with Jesus in your marriage.

breakouts.title: With Jesus in Marriage + Kids
breakouts.summary: Parenthood is primed for opportunities in receiving, reciprocating, and learning kingdom rhythms! Abide in the Father amidst little sleep and lots of love.

breakouts.title: With Jesus in Ministry
breakouts.summary: If you're working in ministry, or feel called to vocational ministry in the future, come join us as we learn what it looks like to steward our personal relationship with Jesus, so we can shepherd God's people from the healthiest place possible!

breakouts.title: With Jesus in the Mundane
breakouts.summary: Most of life isn't mountaintop moments. It's commutes, dishes, and ordinary Tuesdays. Come discover how the everyday, unremarkable parts of your routine can become places where you walk with Jesus, notice His presence, and grow deeper with Him right where you are.

breakouts.title: With Jesus in the Middle of Suffering
breakouts.summary: Seasons of pain and loss can leave us wondering where God is. In this session, we'll talk honestly about walking through hard seasons and explore what it looks like to stay close to Jesus, hold on to hope, and know you're not alone in the middle of it.
